idea: Close the codex-member Skill()/Agent() subagent fan-out gap that degrades ralph's /implement-with-ralph on the codex engine: Phase-2 PRD-gen (convert-to-ralph-prd) and Phase 5a/5b reviewer convergence (code-reviewer/docs-reviewer + code-fixer/docs-updater) cannot run as real subagents, so a codex member hand-scaffolds prd.json and finalizes reviews locally. The shipped codex-ralph-member-multi-agent-adapter (ralph v5.53.0) lowered only the read-only JSON-lens fan-out; this path is uncovered.

candidateDirections.name: Hybrid: write/reviewer subagents via copilot-exec.mjs CLI shell-out, keep read-only lens fan-out on spawn_agent
candidateDirections.summary: When engine=codex, lower the write/context-isolation-critical Agent() sites (code-fixer, docs-updater, criteria-validator, repo-detector) and the prose reviewer sites (code-reviewer, docs-reviewer) to a copilot-exec.mjs CLI shell-out (model claude-opus-4.7-1m-internal) running in the member work_dir — reusing the proven write-capable wrapper — while keeping the read-only parallel lens fan-out on the shipped spawn_agent recipes. Effort L; closes the gate at lowest risk; gated on a copilot-exec-in-worktree smoke.

candidateDirections.name: Extend codex lowering with native WRITE-subagent spawn_agent recipes (gated on a write-child smoke)
candidateDirections.summary: Map the write/edit/reviewer Agent() sites to spawn_agent with a collection contract that handles file edits + commits (git commit/diff checks, not JSON.parse of the final message), add review-changes reviewer sites to AGENT_SITE_INVENTORY, fix the schema-stale recipe (missing required `message`), and plumb features.multi_agent_v2 enablement. Effort XL; the codex-purity graduation; blocked on an unvalidated spawn_agent write-child worktree/commit smoke as the decisive go/no-go.

candidateDirections.name: Codex-native phase rewrite for PRD generation and review convergence
candidateDirections.summary: Restructure the affected phases (make review-changes emit explicit artifact-producing subprocess steps) around codex-native orchestration when engine=codex, rather than per-Agent-site lowering. Effort XL and highest drift risk — a parallel codex-specific implementation that must stay aligned with the Claude/Copilot paths on review persistence, group-mode context_dir, retry-before-fallback, and resume semantics; still needs the same live write-side spawn_agent proof as D-002.

candidateDirections.name: Accept manual/local finalization with a hardened evidence protocol (interim waiver)
candidateDirections.summary: Labeled degraded waiver. NOT gate-closing: code-review keeps the external Codex/Copilot CLI signal, but docs-review loses its ONLY independent reviewer and PRD-gen loses clean-context criteria validation; a member reviewing its own work in its own context loses independent-reviewer signal — unacceptable for re-enabling codex as the DEFAULT engine. Fallback only if D-001 is infeasible.

questionsForSynthesis: Operator decision (load-bearing): may codex-default depend on a Copilot/Claude helper for clean-context write/review phases, or must every subagent be codex-native? All three lenses pivot on this; if must-be-native, D-002 first, gated on the write-child smoke.

Should helper outputs be normalized to the existing Agent contracts (<review-meta>, criteria-validator JSON, repo-detector single path) or should the codex workflows read helper output files directly?
What git + transcript evidence is sufficient to prove the member did NOT inline PRD-gen or review convergence (the dogfood pass/fail signal)?
Fix the schema-stale shipped recipe: spawn_agent emitted without the required `message` field (codex-lowering.mjs:287-296 vs multi_agents_spec.rs:100-103) — file as a separate small bug.
Where is features.multi_agent_v2 enabled for crews codex members (needed even under D-001 so the retained read-only lens fan-out actually runs on a codex member)?
